content.value: You have been appointed as an intern in East West Property Development Ltd (EWPD) of Basundhara Group. You are assigned for the following assignment. The Padma Bridge Connects Louhajong, Munshiganj to Shariatpur and Madaripur, linking the south-west of the country, to northern and eastern regions. The company plans to invest on raw land near the Padma Brige. Now you have to do the following task.
